info.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! API
info.description: API providing data on Yu-Gi-Oh! Trading Card Game cards and sets. Includes routes for card information with extensive filtering by card name, set, rarity, type, archetype, banlist status, and more. Rate limited to 20 requests per second.

get.description: Retrieve Yu-Gi-Oh! card information with extensive filtering options. Supports filtering by name, type, attributes, stats, sets, archetypes, banlists, and more. Response is cached for 2 days on the server side.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The exact name of the card. You can pass multiple pipe-separated names (e.g., 'Baby Dragon|Time Wizard')

parameters.name: fname
parameters.description: A fuzzy search using a string. For example 'Magician' to search all cards with 'Magician' in the name

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The 8-digit passcode of the card. You can pass multiple comma-separated IDs. Cannot be used with 'name' parameter

parameters.name: konami_id
parameters.description: The Konami ID of the card (not the passcode)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of card to filter by (e.g., 'Effect Monster', 'Spell Card', 'Trap Card', 'XYZ Monster'). You can pass multiple comma-separated types

parameters.name: atk
parameters.description: Filter by ATK value. Supports operators: lt (less than), lte (less than or equal), gt (greater than), gte (greater than or equal). Example: 'lt2500' or '2500'

parameters.name: def
parameters.description: Filter by DEF value. Supports operators: lt, lte, gt, gte. Example: 'gte2000'

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Filter by card level/RANK. Supports operators: lt, lte, gt, gte. Example: 'lte8' or '4'

parameters.name: race
parameters.description: Filter by card race/type (e.g., 'Spellcaster', 'Warrior', 'Insect'). For Spell/Trap cards, this is the subtype (e.g., 'Equip', 'Field', 'Counter'). You can pass multiple comma-separated races

parameters.name: attribute
parameters.description: Filter by card attribute (e.g., 'DARK', 'LIGHT', 'WATER', 'FIRE', 'EARTH', 'WIND', 'DIVINE'). You can pass multiple comma-separated attributes

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Filter cards by Link value (for Link Monsters)

parameters.name: linkmarker
parameters.description: Filter cards by Link Marker values (Top, Bottom, Left, Right, Bottom-Left, Bottom-Right, Top-Left, Top-Right). You can pass multiple comma-separated values

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Filter cards by Pendulum Scale value

parameters.name: cardset
parameters.description: Filter cards by card set name (e.g., 'Metal Raiders', 'Soul Fusion')

parameters.name: archetype
parameters.description: Filter cards by archetype (e.g., 'Dark Magician', 'Blue-Eyes', 'Prank-Kids')

parameters.name: banlist
parameters.description: Filter cards by banlist status (TCG, OCG, Goat)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort the order of cards (atk, def, name, type, level, id, new)

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Filter by card format (tcg, goat, ocg goat, speed duel, master duel, rush duel, duel links, genesys). Using 'tcg' returns all cards with a TCG release date and excludes Speed Duel/Rush Duel cards

parameters.name: misc
parameters.description: Pass 'yes' to show additional response information including beta_name, views, upvotes, formats, treated_as, tcg_date, ocg_date, konami_id, md_rarity, has_effect

parameters.name: staple
parameters.description: Filter to show only staple cards. Pass 'yes' to enable

parameters.name: has_effect
parameters.description: Check if a card actually has an effect or not. Pass true/false

parameters.name: startdate
parameters.description: Filter cards released on or after this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Use with 'enddate' and 'dateregion'

parameters.name: enddate
parameters.description: Filter cards released on or before this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Use with 'startdate' and 'dateregion'

parameters.name: dateregion
parameters.description: Specify the region for date filtering (tcg or ocg). Defaults to 'tcg'

parameters.name: tcgplayer_data
parameters.description: Use TCGplayer card set data instead of internal data. This replaces card_sets information with TCGplayer data including set_edition and set_url

429.description: Rate limit exceeded - Blocked for 1 hour after exceeding 20 requests per second

Card.description: Yu-Gi-Oh! card information object. Properties vary based on card type (Monster, Spell, Trap, etc.). Null or empty values are not returned

type.description: The type of card (Normal Monster, Effect Monster, Synchro Monster, XYZ Monster, Spell Card, Trap Card, etc.)

frameType.description: The backdrop frame type (normal, effect, synchro, xyz, spell, trap, link, etc.)

desc.example:
2 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy it.

def.description: DEF value (Monster cards only, not Link Monsters)

level.description: Level or RANK of the card (Monster cards only, not Link Monsters)

race.description: Card race/type. For monsters: Spellcaster, Warrior, Dragon, etc. For Spell/Trap: Field, Equip, Counter, etc.

attribute.description: Attribute of the card (Monster cards only: DARK, LIGHT, WATER, FIRE, EARTH, WIND, DIVINE)

archetype.description: The archetype the card belongs to

ygoprodeck_url.description: URL to the card's page on YGOPRODeck

card_sets.description: Array of card sets this card appears in

card_images.description: Array of card images including alternate artworks

card_prices.description: Array of card prices from various vendors (lowest price across all versions)

views.description: Number of times card has been viewed in database (only when misc=yes)

viewsweek.description: Number of times card has been viewed this week (only when misc=yes)

formats.description: Available formats the card is in (only when misc=yes)

treated_as.description: If the card is treated as another card (e.g., Harpie Lady 1,2,3 are treated as Harpie Lady) (only when misc=yes)

tcg_date.description: Original TCG release date (only when misc=yes)

ocg_date.description: Original OCG release date (only when misc=yes)

konami_id.description: Konami ID of the card (only when misc=yes)

has_effect.description: Whether card has an actual text effect (1=true, 0=false) (only when misc=yes)

genesys_points.description: Genesys format points code (only when format=genesys). Most cards are 0 unless otherwise stated

set_code.description: Set code for this specific printing

set_rarity.description: Rarity of the card in this set

set_price.description: Price in USD for this specific set version

set_edition.description: Edition of the set (only when using tcgplayer_data parameter)

set_url.description: URL to TCGplayer listing (only when using tcgplayer_data parameter)

CardImage.description: Image URLs for a card or alternate artwork

id.description: Card ID for this specific image/artwork

CardPrice.description: Card prices from multiple vendors (lowest price across all versions)

BanlistInfo.description: Banlist status information for the card

ban_tcg.description: Status on TCG banlist (Forbidden, Limited, Semi-Limited, or not listed)

ban_ocg.description: Status on OCG banlist (Forbidden, Limited, Semi-Limited, or not listed)

ban_goat.description: Status on GOAT format banlist (Forbidden, Limited, Semi-Limited, or not listed)
